title: RejectRules
description: Design Knowledge Engine (Phase 6.5) Section 9 — the real hard-reject thresholds engine/candidateEngine.ts's applyHardRejectRules enforces, externalized as editable data instead of buried TypeScript literals. This file documents the exact current behavior of that function; it is authoritative reference data, not a second enforcement path — candidateEngine.ts imports getHardNodeBudget() from knowledge/rules for the one numeric threshold, and the structural checks (empty pattern / NaN-Infinity / raster image / external ref / duplicate ids) stay real code in candidateEngine.ts because they are regex/structural logic, not tunable numbers.

hardNodeBudget.description: Maximum SVG node count before a candidate is hard-rejected as unsafe to render/export. Mirrors engine/candidateEngine.ts's HARD_NODE_BUDGET.
